verdict.rationale: Publishing current processing times is a fair question for an IP office like INPI, so the axis applies. However, none of the evidence items mention published processing times or delays for any transaction type: the filing pages, guidelines, decisions and homepage items cover procedures and services only, and the data.inpi.fr probe concerns API access, not processing-time disclosure.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself
